title: Frontier Feud: Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta FAIR, Thinking Machines — Barr Yaron, Amplify
talk_summary: This is a Family Feud-style game show at an AI Engineer conference where researchers from Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta FAIR, and Thinking Machines guess survey answers from 100 AI engineers. It contains no technical content, no mechanisms, and no engineering techniques—only audience survey popularity results.

takeaways.technique: Survey signal: cost is the top model-selection criterion
takeaways.what_they_do: They surveyed 100 AI engineers on top considerations when choosing a model; 'cost' was revealed as the number one answer, ahead of latency, benchmarks, and capabilities.
takeaways.evidence_quote: price so cost is the number one answer which actually surprised me
